final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and to meet the docstring specifications:

1. In bookings/billing.py, the billable_blocks function was incorrectly using round() which rounds to the nearest integer. I changed it to always round up by using integer division with adjustment and added a check to raise ValueError if minutes is negative.

2. In bookings/schedule.py, the add_slot function used a mutable default argument (slots=[]), which causes shared state between calls. I changed the default to None and created a new list inside the function to avoid shared state.

3. In bookings/timeutil.py, the parse_duration function only supported the "XhYm" format. I extended it to support all the formats described in the docstring: "Xh", "Ym", "H:M", and bare minutes, raising ValueError if none match.

These changes ensure all functions behave as their docstrings specify and the tests pass. No test files were modified.
